meta.name: architecture-decision
meta.description: 创建架构决策记录（Architecture Decision Record, ADR），记录重大技术决策及其背景、备选方案和影响后果。每个重大技术选择都应有对应的 ADR。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记录技术决策的背景与影响
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要系统化记录重大技术决策及其理由。
copy.tagline_en: Document the context and impact of technical decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to systematically record major technical decisions and their rationale.

howto.what: 当你要求记录技术决策时，Claude会自动生成一份标准格式的架构决策记录（ADR），包含背景、备选方案、影响等，并保存到指定文件夹。
howto.when: 当你明确要求记录某个架构决策时触发，例如说出“记录我们选择用微服务的决策”，或者直接调用此技能。

say.text: 记录我们决定用React而不是Vue的架构决策
say.note: Claude将扫描现有ADR并生成新记录

say.text: 创建一个ADR说明为何采用PostgreSQL
say.note: Claude会引导你完成决策细节

howto.what_en: When asked to record a technical decision, Claude automatically creates a standard Architecture Decision Record (ADR) with context, alternatives, impacts, etc., and saves it to a designated folder.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask to record an architecture decision, e.g., "Record our decision to use microservices", or by invoking this skill directly.

say_en.text: Record our decision to use React instead of Vue
say_en.note: Claude scans existing ADRs and creates a new one

say_en.text: Create an ADR explaining why we chose PostgreSQL
say_en.note: Claude guides you through decision details

say_en.text: Generate an ADR for database selection
